label: FOSSEE Summer Fellowship
source: https://fossee.in/fellowship/<year> - the per-year result tables FOSSEE publishes (2020: 81, 2021: 12, 2022: 38, 2023: 29, 2024: 23, 2025: 72, 2026: 121)
note: One row per fellowship project in the outcome table FOSSEE (IIT Bombay) publishes for each year it has run the Summer Fellowship - 7 years read, 376 rows in total. The title is the page's "Project name" cell, the organization is its "Floss Name" cell (the FOSS codebase the fellow worked on) or FOSSEE itself for the years whose table has no such column, and the link is the program's own project report page on static.fossee.in; 22 row(s) whose table cell carries no report link fall back to that year's fellowship page instead. 8 report links were re-read this run and 0 did not answer. FOSSEE names the fellow and the institute, not a mentor, so the fellow and institute sit in the blurb and `m` is empty; no row carries a repository, stars or a language because the fellowship table does not publish them. Applicant screening tables on the same pages are ignored - a screening task is not a fellowship project - and where a year repeats the same result list in two tables (2020 does) each fellow and project is kept once.
